bio: Claudia and Manuel Ressi bring warmth and dedication to the running of this charming restaurant on the main square. The cuisine showcases select regional ingredients, which are presented in a kind of hybrid concept. On the one hand, there are the Wirtshaus-Klassiker à la carte (eg beef soup or Gailtal spare ribs); then there is the Bärenwanderung set menu with creative, modern dishes such as mountain water – Kärntner Lax'n (trout), baby leek, quiche, peas, sprouts. You can also choose individual dishes from the set menu. The restaurant has two dining areas: one distinctly traditional small space and a more modern area, plus a nice terrace in front of the house.
